changelog:
Initial release with collaborative project skeletonization workflow.

- Introduces a standardized process for converting a full business project into a reusable skeleton/template.
- Requires confirmation before deleting or refactoring files by presenting an inventory, keep/remove lists, and uncertain items.
- Supports major stacks: Spring Boot, Vue, Node.js, Python, React, Django, FastAPI, Express.
- Emphasizes preserving common framework capabilities (e.g., authentication, routing, health checks) while removing business-specific features.
- Provides guidance on placeholder APIs/pages and stack-specific removal/retention strategies.
